g.text: athlete : Athlete [0..1] // set on confirm, cleared by undo, delete or a merge
confirmation : ConfirmationRecord [0..1] «new» // exactly what a confirmation wrote; cleared by undo/merge
matchAthlete : Athlete [0..1] «new» // saved match (2.1, 2.2); only while athlete is unset
trigger : every registration | if member | manual
user : User // users-permissions; null password hash until invite accepted
coachDisabledAt // coach side off, the account stays active
teamMember : TeamMember [0..1] // unique link; cleared when the team member is deleted (account is disabled first)
An invite to the e-mail of an account with no team member
re-links it: status invited, password and Google link cleared,
devices and sessions ended. An e-mail change also ends
key : string // typed e-mail or IP, not an account
email : string // the athlete e-mail at the time of the grant
revokeReason : scos | email_schimbat | anonimizat | sters | unit
athleteKey : string // athlete id; one live row per athlete (partial unique index)
Status is derived from the account (invited, active, disabled).
Follows the athlete e-mail: a change moves it to the account
of the new address; anonymize, delete and merge end it.
the undo plan reverts exactly this, nothing added since):
membershipId : the membership this confirmation created
seasonId : the season whose group/A.C.S. this wrote to,
null when none, absent on pre-3A rows (undo falls back
Green «existing»: today, unchanged. Orange «changed»: today, gets new fields.
